title: Mall World Road Trips
content: Hi guys! I love reading the posts on here and I have been spending some time remembering my own vivid dreams that are reminiscent of the mall world. Sometimes I visit THE mall on these road trips, but other times it's just the same internal feeling. A lot of my stress related dreams revolve around going on a road trip or long drive. Here are some of the things that happen in no particular order: -Sometimes I'm driving, sometimes I am the passenger. Usually I'm driving a huge van my dad used to own. It's hard to turn and there's bad visibility with no back windows. When I'm driving, the road is winding and precarious and once in a while i'll go off the road and wake up before I crash. Usually my last thoughts are, "Oh man, all the other times I've dreamed this were fake, but this time I really messed up." The roads are sometimes out in nature, like the drive to Big Bear CA, and sometimes are twisting freeways that criss cross around the outside of the mall/parking lot -omg i get lost in the parking lot all the time. It's concrete and open air, but it's huge and parking sucks even though there's usually not a lot of people there. The lanes are hard to navigate and narrow, so there's a lot of 3-point turns. -The car will disappear entirely and the freeway is a huge empty pathway where groups of people are walking. Sometimes I'll run into someone I know. Sometimes we're walking away from where our homes were destroyed and other times it's just how people get around. -My brakes won't stop my car completely no matter how hard I press on them. -I'll suddenly be mid family road trip. I'll feel disoriented and unsure of where we're going, and my biggest fear is that I've forgotten my medication (something that happened once irl). Usually I'm underprepared and haven't packed adequate clothing. -It's a school trip and I'm traveling on bus/plane with classmates and someone (or me) will be left behind and need to catch the next train/bus/etc. The airports & stations are confusing and bright and unfamiliar. They're usually underground and attached to a bar/restaurant. It's also right next door to my childhood home when I leave. -I visit this seaside town that I've never seen IRL. It's somewhere on the Pacific coast with a lot of light blue bungalow houses and places for RVs to park. I believe it's mostly for vacationing people because it's so empty. The shoreline is really short and the tide will come up and wash you away if you fall asleep. It comes unexpectedly and really quickly. Sometimes I get caught in the waves when I'm swimming and have to swim parallel to the shore to get out of the riptide. -A mansion/large cabin that I visit. Sometimes I'm there to take care of a client, sometimes I am there as a guest of a family friend, and sometimes I'm visiting an estate sale. It's multi storied, with a mysterious basement and lots of hidden rooms. There's one room that's also a gift shop and has tons of trinkets and tchotchkes the owner of the house collected over the years. I remember a lot of wooden, cabin-y banisters and bridges criss- crossing the main floor. When you walk in, to the left is a dining room and to the right is a fancy, high end kitchen but it's usually messy. Behind the kitchen is a sitting room where moms are gossiping, and when I walk by they want me to stop and say hello. To the left is one of the staircases that go up to the bedrooms, some of which you need to walk through in order to get to another. All of these instances have happened but not all during the same dream (usually). I find that if I have sugar before bed or eat in the middle of the night, they get worse lol.
